title: introduction body (sealed)
description: Introduce the receiver to another member, who is sent an introduction too, naming the receiver (spec/protocol.md section 5.18). Its owner decides it like any request. Comes with the feature introduction. Sealed: derived from actions/introduction.schema.json by spec/conformance/generate.mjs, every x-obi-text field a sealed_text (spec/protocol.md section 9.1). Don't edit it by hand.

member.description: The member introduced: an active member, neither the sender nor the receiver.

about.description: What the two might work on together: repositories, pull requests, issues.
